newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Meilin confident of beating 1996 net target.
newsitem.headline: Meilin confident of beating 1996 net target.

text.p: Hefei Meilin Co Ltd is confident of beating its 1996 net profit target of 138 million yuan, under international accounting standards, due to stronger demand for its refrigerators, a spokesman said on Friday.
In January-October this year, Meilin sold 720,000 refrigerators, against 750,000 in the whole of 1995, he told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin.
The official said Meilin's new, freon-free refrigerators should contribute more than 10 million yuan to after-tax profits this year, with production of 200,000 refrigerators in 1996.
Some 70 million yuan of proceeds from the firm's recent B share offer will be used for production.
Meilin's B shares were offered at HK$3.07 each earlier this year and listed in Shenzhen in August.

The official said the firm's 75 percent-owned Hefei Meilin Washing Machine Co Ltd, acquired by the Shenzhen-listed firm for 68 million yuan, also part of the B share proceeds, would produce 150,000 washing machines this year. He did not issue a profit forecast for the subsidiary.
